g.text: The algebra tower: trait refinement and the strength order
A semi-decidable algebra implements HeytingAlgebra DIRECTLY and
does NOT implement BooleanAlgebra — so SFA complement / determinize /
equivalence are statically unavailable on it (Property 4.1; a
compile_fail doctest turns the safety property into a checked artifact).
The Z3/SMT leg (logict_smt::Z3Theory) is a ConstraintTheory ONLY — it deliberately
does NOT implement BooleanAlgebra, so it never enters this classical tier; its
verdict is the 3-valued Sat3 (DontKnow ⇒ no entailment claimed). See doc 13 §2.1.
semi-decidable tier (reject-safe / Heyting — the caution color)
